newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Helix in further Gawler Craton find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Helix in further Gawler Craton find.

text.p: Mineral explorer Helix Resources NL said on Wednesday it had confirmed additional significant gold mineralisation in Area 223 of the Tunkillia Prospect at Lake Everard in the Gawler Craton region of South Australia.

Helix said significant intercepts from Area 223 included 2.1 grams per tonne (g/t) gold over 92 metres and 3.4 g/t over 72 metres. The results follow an earlier well-received drilling report on November 18.
Helix, which owns 100 percent of the Lake Everard project, said the second line of reverse circulation drilling confirmed the high prospectivity of Area 223.
The company said it would maintain its focus on the Gawler Craton region during 1997.
